title: Solo Bitcoin Miner Wins $191,000 Block Reward With Just 11 TH/s
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Solo Bitcoin Miner Wins $191,000 Block Reward With Just 11 TH/s A solo miner with about 11.1 TH/s found Bitcoin block 977,057 through CKpool, collecting 3.1287 BTC. The CKpool developer put the odds at about 1 in 1,650 a year. This post Solo Bitcoin Miner Wins $191,000 Block Reward With Just 11 TH/s first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
